title: An article's sources header lists the ids its Reference table rows cite, and lint warns of one it misses
goal: auth/issuer-token-rotation.md, auth/propagation-latency.md and security/settings-crosswalk.md list in their sources header every source id their Reference table rows cite (S-fsqu2grq and S-ytnvr75r among them), and the contract lint warns of a table-row id missing from the header

run: import re,sys;t=open('kb/public/auth/issuer-token-rotation.md').read();h=re.search(r'^sources: \[(.*)\]',t,re.M).group(1);sys.exit(0 if 'S-fsqu2grq' in h and 'S-ytnvr75r' in h else 1)
